context: A uni student and a teen friend debrief a weekend night
purpose: Teach: カラオケ/シャワー/親父/外出/ねこ/飲ま/眠っ/つまらない

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨日のカラオケ、めっちゃ盛り上がったよな。
lines.en: Last night's karaoke was such a blast, wasn't it?
lines.style: Casual upbeat tone with rising energy, college-guy vibe

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、でも先輩、ビール飲まなかったでしょ?
lines.en: Yeah, but senpai, you didn't drink any beer, right?
lines.style: Teasing teen voice with playful curiosity, light upward inflection

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちの親父にバレたらヤバいからさ、ジュースだけ。
lines.en: If my old man found out it'd be bad, so just juice.
lines.style: Sheepish chuckle, lowering voice slightly, embarrassed admission

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あはは、家、外出も厳しいって言ってたもんね。
lines.en: Haha, you said even going out is strict at your place.
lines.style: Bright laughter then sympathetic teen tone, warm and casual

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 帰って速攻シャワー浴びて、そのまま眠っちゃった。
lines.en: I rushed home, took a shower, and just passed out.
lines.style: Tired sigh with a soft laugh, recounting the night drowsily

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちのねこも夜中ずっと鳴いてて、全然寝れなかった。
lines.en: My cat was meowing all night, I couldn't sleep at all.
lines.style: Whiny teen complaint with mock exhaustion, slight pout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは大変だな。次はもっと派手な店行こうぜ、つまらない夜は嫌だし。
lines.en: That sounds rough. Next time let's hit a flashier place — boring nights suck.
lines.style: Encouraging confident tone, planning ahead with cheerful determination

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 賛成! 今度こそ朝までコースね、先輩!
lines.en: Agreed! Next time we're going till morning for sure, senpai!
lines.style: Excited teen enthusiasm, voice bouncing with anticipation and energy
